mechanism_summary: The pod template of deployment web/storefront references image registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1, which does not exist on the registry: every pull attempt is rejected by containerd with a not found error, kubelet backs off between attempts (ErrImagePull, then ImagePullBackOff), and the containers are never created or started.
decisive_evidence: Pod events in web for the storefront pods: reason Failed with message 'Failed to pull image "registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1": ... registry.k8s.io/retail/storefront:2.4.1: not found' — the containerd not-found message naming the exact image reference — plus the BackOff events it produces.
remediation_summary: Update the storefront deployment's container image to a reference that actually exists (kubectl -n web set image deployment/storefront storefront=<existing storefront release reference>); the pod template image field is mutable, so the rollout proceeds and the pods start once the reference resolves.
